howto.name: Paste Markdown or HTML
howto.text: Auto-detects direction. Markdown → HTML for publishing; HTML → Markdown for content extraction.

howto.name: Click Convert
howto.text: Standard CommonMark spec for Markdown. HTML converts to GitHub-flavored Markdown.

faq.q: What about extensions like tables and code blocks?
faq.a: GitHub-flavored Markdown extensions are supported in both directions: tables, fenced code, strikethrough, task lists.
Conversion is opinionated — visible content keeps semantics, but custom CSS is stripped. For a faithful HTML→PDF, use the Markdown-to-PDF tool instead.
HTML → Markdown can lose nesting fidelity (deeply-nested divs flatten). Markdown → HTML is exact.
